content: Alɔɔŋ a loor

Asànaa bàkäl aŋangɔɔm a loor uboo a un'sɛŋ a Isàlɛl, abun sye, bàsàkal alɔɔŋ a loor uboo a bɛ. Ba bàsàbiil an'lɔɔŋ an'be a ntwan, tii mutɔn Un'lɔɔŋ awà katsü mɔ̈ɔ̈. Kwɛl a mbɔɔn tɛy, ma màsabwiy ndwaŋ.
Baar mbɔɔn bàsàlab mbweel a ndwaŋ aba. Ntɔn ba, mbwo a ndandaa isàbulà undiir mwɛy wàŋàbɛy.
Unsà küüb a ngim, alɔɔŋ a loor abà bàsàwal indiir abɛ u mbwo ndaa a ntsà. Wɛɛ ntɔn ba, fà itaan, ntaaŋàmbar aba kwɛl yatɛy anà ukwà aba bàyàfàdil anki.
Ntɔn, Nzam kàwɛy anki akyeey bàkyer man'be, wɛɛ nde katɔɔm u nsye a mbaa, bàŋàbäm an'dwaaŋ ntɔn mudil mbar.

Nde sye kàwɛy anki taaŋ là itaan, wɛɛ nde kàyee Nɔwà, mbuur wànaan uboo a baar bàsɔrà unsà ukwà, nde mbuur kàlɔɔŋà balàbal umpal kàdwä Nzam baar abe kà an'dà umpal kànɔ̈ mbul a ikül.
Ungö apan, nde kàpɛ ntaaŋàmbar akà an'bul a Sɔdɔm anà Gɔmɔr anà ma mabulà un'twà ntɔn muswaŋ mbaan akà baar abe abà bàsàyà ungö.
Wɛɛ nde kàtsü Lɔt mɔ̈ɔ̈, mbuur a balàbal awà kàwem ngyɛb ntɔn isal aŋingyäy byà atɔŋ ande.
Ntɔn mbuur a balàbal awà kàkäl umwɛy uboo a ba, nde kàkyer amanà anà kàkyer awemà: ilä ungö ilä, mpem ande yàkyer ayɔɔ ntɔn isal aba byà ŋingyäy.
Abun, Mwol an'kwo ulwom u nsii baar a balàbal anà usi ukɔl baar mpa abà bàbalàbal ntɔn mukapà ntaaŋàmbar kà ilä a nsaŋ.

Ntaaŋàmbar ayi yà sin sin ntɔn baar bàfàkwen ŋingyäy. Ba bàfàlab ilään a ndür aba anà bàfàbɛy ikɔ̈b a Nzam. Alɔɔŋ a loor abà bye anà gyɔɔr anà uyɔl, bɔɔmà akà ba batɛy mubweel baar a làkoo a du in'tswe.
Itàkal akyeey ban'lyaaŋ ikɔ̈b anà ngwal udu a ba, bàfàtɛn anki ndaa a nswɛn akà ba u mii a Mwol.
Wɛɛ ba bà asànaa ntsür a insil ifàkwɛlà anà ifàkwà unsà intaam. Ba bàfàto indiir mpa bàyöb ba. Ba bàkyer asàpɔɔn asànaa ufàpɔɔn ntsür.
Abà, ba bàsàwal làfur a un'kɔl aŋàyↄŋ aba. Un'sak aba wàmukyer ndaa a nswɛn kà imɛɛy.
Mii aba myàŋàyɔl a inswem, ba bàfàyuur anki mukyer man'be, ba bàfàlwab baar mpa abàŋàtsim. Ba bàkyàtoo làpaan a ngyal a ngim. Un'küül a Nzam wà udu a ba!
Ba ban'wɛy mbwo a swalaa, ba ban'yiiŋ ntɔn mulab mbwo a Bàlam mwan a Bɔsɔr, awà kàbü unsà ndɛb a làfur làkɔ̈ɔ̈n balàbal,
wɛɛ nde kàwɛl làfur a un'tswe bwoor ande: ntsür a nkiin mwɛy wà isal kàsi ndaa asànaa mbuur, abun, ukɔŋ a ŋangɔɔm awà waa bàwü.
Baar abà bà asànaa ntwà mpa ifàtwey an'dà anà an'tööb ufiisyen un'pöb. Ba bàkyalɔ̈ɔ̈n ikal u diŋàdiŋ a mpib.
Abun, unsà an'lɔɔŋ aba màŋàyam a uyɔl anà màbunàbun, ba bàfàlwab baar ban'sɔrà benàben kà an'kɔɔ a baar abye anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ un'be.
Ba bàfasyeel ilää ntɔn mukapà insaay, wɛɛ, kyekà ba ŋakwo bà asɔ a ilään ifatwääl ukwà, ntɔn mbuur wanswà wà un'sɔ a undiir awà afun'yaal.

Abun, isàkal naa baar bàsɔrà kà an'kɔɔ a mbiin a mɛɛn u mbwo a ngyööb a Yɛsu Klistɔ, Mwol anà Un'tswää a mɔ̈ɔ̈ abi, ban'fàbwà anà bàmàfayaal unsà mbiin a mɛɛn, mpay aba yàngöngö yan'söön yàtàtwɛb.
Ntɔn yàlàkal ubwaŋ akà ba mukɔɔn ayöb mbwo a balàbal, wɛɛ kàmuyöb ya anki, waa ungö bàfàtɔn nswɛɛŋ a in'kyɛɛl ayà bàtöm.
Ya yayeel asànaa kyàtɛn itim asànaa ayà ya: « Mbwà kan'fàfurà kà ilwo ande » naa sye: « Ngul un'kyay bàmun'ywɛy làbenàben, kan'fàbibimà uboo a antwar. »
